sample_data_labeling_and_limitations.dataset_nature: Curated multilingual grievance sample dataset (Hindi, English, Hinglish).
sample_data_labeling_and_limitations.sample_size_limitation: Sample size is limited to 610 samples (approx 15 per class). In production municipal deployments with 10,000+ complaints, variance will stabilize.
sample_data_labeling_and_limitations.calibration_assessment: Model confidence outputs are raw multinomial logistic softmax scores, NOT calibrated probabilities. Fitting post-hoc calibration (Platt scaling or Isotonic regression) requires a sizable independent validation split. With only 120 total samples (90 train / 30 test) across 8 classes, an additional validation split would starve the training set (<8 samples per class). Fitting a calibrator on the held-out test set would violate evaluation integrity. Therefore, raw scores are retained and the 0.35 confidence threshold is treated as an experimental triage heuristic.
sample_data_labeling_and_limitations.spelling_variation_challenge: Informal phonetic Hinglish exhibits heavy orthographic variation (e.g., 'paani' vs 'pani' vs 'paani nahi aa raha'). Character n-grams and sublinear TF mitigate this, but extreme dialectal slang may require phonetic normalization.
sample_data_labeling_and_limitations.semantic_overlap_limitation: Real-world grievances frequently cross domains (e.g. 'broken road with flooded sewage' overlaps Civic Infrastructure and Water Drainage). The model outputs full probability distributions to provide transparency into borderline cases.
sample_data_labeling_and_limitations.continuous_learning_recommendation: Use the '/api/ml/retrain' endpoint to continuously incorporate verified citizen tickets into the training corpus as new complaints are resolved.
